A landlord, or
agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply
to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which
exceeds $50.
fields.note: Cap, CPI adjustment, penalties, enforcement, remittance and rulemaking all match the text.

fields.quoted_span:
shall be liable for a penalty of up to $500 for a
first offense, up to $750 for a second offense, and up to $1,000 for each
subsequent offense
fields.note: The $50 cap appears in subsection a; CPI adjustment begins January 1 of the year after enactment (2027).
